title: "Week 02: AI-assisted dev"

## Introduction

This week, we'll explore the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-assisted software development. We'll compare browser chats, use GitHub Copilot inside VS Code, and install both GitHub Copilot CLI and Antigravity CLI. You'll give the two CLI agents the same small Python task, compare their suggestions, and use tests and `git diff` to decide what to keep.

## Recommended readings

- [GitHub Copilot documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot) - Official guide to GitHub Copilot
- [The art of prompt engineering](https://github.com/features/copilot/prompt-engineering) - Best practices for prompting AI code assistants
- [Copilot CLI installation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-cli/set-up-copilot-cli/install-copilot-cli) - Official setup instructions
- [Antigravity CLI overview](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview/) - Official setup and usage guide
